messages:
IncidentBot: Paging — p95 latency spike detected for prod-eu inference cluster (severity: P2). Alert: sustained >2x baseline p95 over last 5m. Runbook: https://redwood.ops/runbooks/latency-spike

Alex R.: I'm oncall. acknowledging. looking at console now, seeing queue depth up on pool-gpu-7.

Maya L.: Taking lead. Can you post the last deploy id? I'll grab logs. Also let's get a status page up. :eyes: 

Samir K.: recent kernel tuning (deploy id deploy-20260312-348) landed ~10m before symptoms started. KV cache eviction counts spiking in metrics.

Lina C.: Heads-up — a handful of EU customers are seeing 5-20s p95. Support notified. Drafting customer advisory now.

Alex R.: Quick triage: 1) model-variant fallback happening more often => extra tokens compute; 2) eviction increases cold-starts.

Maya L.: Mitigation plan (executing now):
1) Pause low-priority batch jobs: run `/scripts/pause-batches --region eu --reason latency`
2) Scale up dedicated warm pool: `infra scale dedicated --pool pool-gpu-7 --delta 4 --timeout 300`
3) Route 20% of traffic to prod-us-west for non-EU customers and tenants that can tolerate region failover.

Commands I'm running:
```
# pause batches
ssh ops@runner-03 'bash /srv/scripts/pause-batches --region eu --reason latency'
# bump pool
infractl allocate --pool pool-gpu-7 --count 4 --priority warm
# shift traffic
curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/shifts -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"from":"eu","to":"us-west","percent":20}'
```

Alex R.: I'm going to open the status page update. Draft below, please edit:
"We are investigating increased inference latency affecting EU region. Partial mitigation in progress (traffic routing and capacity increase). Expected improvement within 30-45 minutes. We will update as we have more details."

Lina C.: Customer notification draft (short):
"We are investigating elevated latency in our EU inference service. We have started mitigation steps and expect gradual recovery over the next 30-45 minutes. We will follow up once service returns to normal. If you need immediate assistance, reply here or contact support@redwood.com."

SupportBot: Notified support channel with advisory draft. Ticket templates queued.

Samir K.: I rolled back the kernel tuning flag on node group pool-gpu-7 (deploy-20260312-348 -> reverted). Observing initial drop in eviction rate.

Maya L.: Good catch. Eviction rate down 40% in the last 2m, p95 trending down from 6.2s to 3.1s. Continuing to monitor. Will keep traffic shift at 20% until p95 < 1.5s for 5m.

Alex R.: Handoff: I'm leaving and handing on-call to Maya in ~10m. Maya, I've pinned the mitigation steps in the incident doc and added links to logs.

Maya L.: Acknowledged. I'll take it through to resolution. If anyone sees customer degradations beyond the draft, ping me @Maya L.

IncidentBot: Status page updated to "Degraded performance" (https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1765003210). Next update scheduled in 15 minutes.

Lina C.: After-action comms checklist: 1) timeline, 2) root cause hypothesis (KV eviction after kernel tuning), 3) mitigation steps, 4) customer impact summary (tenants affected, SLO breach window), 5) follow-ups (e.g., revert rollout, test lower batch thresholds).

Samir K.: Plan for rollback patch: prepare a canary with the revert applied, run load tests, then roll cluster-wide if green. I'll coordinate with eng-runtime and infra.

Alex R.: Thanks team. I'll send a brief to stakeholders with current status and expected timeframe.

Maya L.: Update — p95 at 1.4s now, eviction counts normalized. Keeping monitoring for 10m. If stable, we'll close incident and post RCA draft.

IncidentBot: Incident status changed to "mitigated" at 1765003615. Please file postmortem in /incidents/postmortems/1765003210.
